verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto on/off-ramp and swap platform, so agent wallet issuance is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence describes programmatic wallets for agents, scoped keys, policy controls, or documented limits on what an agent can move. The only wallet mention is creating a wallet for human users by email during a purchase, and the MCP server only gives agents access to search the documentation.
